item.title: Cal Lutheran to close Oxnard satelite campus
item.description: OXNARD, California. (KEYT) California Lutheran University's satellite campus in Oxnard is set to close this summer. The campus is located in The Palms mixed use complex in Oxnard. A similar satelitte campus in Westlake is also set to close. The Ventura County Star has reported that the closure plans follows declining enrollment.
